# MDL311 · `invalid-utf8`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A line contains bytes that are not valid UTF-8.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | values |
| Default severity | warning |
| Fix | — |
| Design references | K16 |

## Why

GLib reads the bytes as they are, but prints them as U+FFFD in messages, and GLib's option parser rejects such a value in a string option in every UTF-8 locale (MDL409). The file was probably saved in a legacy encoding such as Latin-1: re-save it as UTF-8.

## Example

❌ Before:

```text
[mydumper]
# caf\xe9
database=caf\xe9
regex=ok
```

(`\r`, `\t` and `\xHH` stand for the bytes they name, `·` for a trailing space)

```text
2:6-2:7 warning MDL311[invalid-utf8] invalid UTF-8: the file is probably not saved as UTF-8
3:13-3:14 warning MDL311[invalid-utf8] invalid UTF-8: the file is probably not saved as UTF-8
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL311: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL311` on the line above it.
